# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 renderer with upstream engine fixes. Linux font fallback can select a different fontconfig face after this update, so applications requiring deterministic typography should choose an explicit or bundled typeface.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path, which can change fallback glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family and style, or a bundled typeface, when deterministic font selection matters. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and includes its upstream bug-fix sync. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
